definitions.gloss: honest; upright; incorruptible; clean and principled
definitions.explanation: Describes a person of integrity who is free from corruption, dishonesty, or self-serving behavior. Often used to describe politicians, officials, or leaders who are morally upright.

examples.japanese: {清廉|せいれん}な⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: He is known as an incorruptible politician.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{清廉|せいれん}な⟦{人柄|ひとがら}→人柄：08163_hitogara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{尊敬|そんけい}→尊敬：01454_sonkei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: His honest character is respected by many people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{清廉潔白|せいれんけっぱく}→清廉潔白：30789_seirenkeppaku⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Leaders are expected to be completely honest and above reproach.

notes:
A な-adjective composed of {清|せい} (pure, clean) + {廉|れん} (honest, upright). A literary, formal word used primarily in discussing public figures and moral character.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {清廉|せいれん}な⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧: an incorruptible politician
- {清廉|せいれん}な⟦{人柄|ひとがら}→人柄：08163_hitogara⟧: an honest character
- ⟦{清廉潔白|せいれんけっぱく}→清廉潔白：30789_seirenkeppaku⟧: spotlessly clean, above reproach (four-character compound)
- {清廉|せいれん}さ: integrity, incorruptibility

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{誠実|せいじつ}→誠実：14211_seijitsu⟧: sincere, honest — broader meaning, used in personal relationships too
- ⟦{高潔|こうけつ}→高潔：22418_kouketsu⟧: noble, high-minded — emphasizes moral elevation
- {廉潔|れんけつ}: upright, integrity — very similar, slightly more literary
